question: Should OpenClaw preserve below-threshold keyword-only hybrid hits at the manager selection boundary, or consolidate that behavior with the overlap-aware merge approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92341?
rationale: Both paths address non-overlapping vector and keyword results but establish different long-term retrieval invariants; code review cannot safely choose the product ranking policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt manager-side preservation
options.body: Rebase this PR and accept keyword-backed recall as a manager selection policy while keeping exact-id merge semantics.

options.title: Consolidate with merge-layer work
options.body: Ask the authors to produce one current-main patch that resolves the same user case without parallel fallback rules.

options.title: Defer ranking policy
options.body: Keep both proposals open until maintainers define the intended `minScore` and hybrid-recall contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt manager-side preservation
recommendation.body: Rebase this PR and accept keyword-backed recall as a manager selection policy while keeping exact-id merge semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest evidenced technical contact across the overlapping non-overlap and CJK retrieval reports, though final product acceptance remains with repository leadership.
